results.name: Dumbbell Standing Hip Abduction
instructions: Stand upright with your feet together and hold a dumbbell against the outside of one thigh with the same-side hand.
Shift your weight onto the opposite leg, engage your core, and keep your supporting knee slightly bent.
Keep your working leg straight and lift it out and upward to the side while maintaining an upright torso and keeping your toes facing forward.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower your leg with control and repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your supporting foot firmly planted and distribute your weight across the entire foot.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning away from the working leg.
Avoid swinging your leg or using momentum to raise the dumbbell.
Exhale as you lift your leg and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Standing Hip Abduction is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Core, Obliques.

results.name: Frog Jumps
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width apart and your toes turned slightly outward. Lower into a deep squat and reach both hands toward the floor between your feet.
Push through your feet and jump straight upward, extending your hips and knees.
Land softly in the same wide stance and immediately bend your knees.
Lower back into the squat, reach toward the floor, and continue repeating the movement.
tips: Keep your chest lifted and avoid rounding your lower back in the squat.
Bend your knees immediately upon landing to absorb the impact.
Fully extend your hips and knees at the top of each jump.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you jump upward.
results.description: Frog Jumps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core, Adductors.

results.name: Glute Bridge Bodyweight
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Brace your core and press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower and repeat.
tips: Don't arch your lower back at the top.
Keep your knees in line with your feet.
results.description: Glute Bridge Bodyweight is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Glute Bridge With Abduction Bodyweight
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart. Place your arms at your sides with palms facing down.
Engage your core and glutes and lift your hips towards the ceiling until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
While holding the bridge position, spread your knees apart as far as comfortable, keeping your feet flat on the floor.
Bring your knees back together, then lower your hips back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your hips remain lifted and in line with your body during the abduction movement.
Avoid letting your knees collapse inward; maintain control during the abduction movement.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you lift your hips and spread your knees, and inhaling as you lower your hips.
results.description: Glute Bridge With Abduction Bodyweight is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Good Mornings
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, bend your knees slightly, and place your hands beside your head with your elbows pointing outward.
Push your hips back and hinge your torso forward while keeping your back straight.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor or until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to return upright, then repeat.
tips: Keep your weight balanced over your heels and midfoot.
Lower only as far as you can without rounding your back.
Push your hips backward instead of lowering into a squat.
Inhale as you hinge forward and exhale as you stand upright.
results.description: Good Mornings is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core.

results.name: Hack Squat Machine
instructions: Position yourself on the hack squat machine with your shoulders under the pads and your feet shoulder-width apart on the foot platform. Keep your back pressed against the backrest.
Release the safety handles and slowly lower your body by bending your knees until your thighs are parallel to the foot platform.
Push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back pressed against the backrest throughout the exercise.
Focus on keeping your knees aligned with your toes to avoid straining your joints.
Exhale as you push up and inhale as you lower your body.
results.description: Hack Squat Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Alternating Legs
instructions: Lie face down on the Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl machine, placing your ankles under the leg pads and holding the handles on the sides of the machine for stability. Start with both legs fully extended.
Curl one leg by bending your knee and pulling your ankle towards your glutes, keeping the other leg extended.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement and slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hips pressed against the bench throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your hamstrings throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Alternating Legs is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Single Leg
instructions: Lie face down on the Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl machine, placing your ankles under the leg pads and holding the handles on the sides of the machine for stability. Start with both legs fully extended.
Curl your right leg by bending your knee and pulling your ankle towards your glutes, keeping the other leg extended.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top of the movement and slowly lower your leg back to the starting position with control.
Repeat with the same leg for the desired number of repetitions and then switch to your left leg and repeat.
tips: Keep your hips pressed against the bench throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your hamstrings throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Single Leg is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Both Legs
instructions: Lie face down on the Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl machine, placing your ankles under the leg pads and holding the handles on the sides of the machine for stability. Start with both legs fully extended.
Curl both legs by bending your knees and pulling your ankles towards your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings at the top of the movement and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your hips pressed against the bench throughout the exercise.
Focus on engaging your hamstrings throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl your leg and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Leg Curl Both Legs is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Hip-Thrust in Smith Machine
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the Smith bar over your hips, with a pad.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower and repeat.
tips: Tuck your chin and keep your ribs down.
Use a bar pad for comfort.
results.description: Hip-Thrust in Smith Machine is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a smith machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Quadriceps.
